senses.en: To use something effectively for a particular purpose.

ex.en: The assignment is to utilize resources, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先利用资源，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to utilize resources and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你利用资源，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: utilize available space｜利用现有空间
tip: 比use正式；英式也常拼作utilise。

senses.en: An electronic component that amplifies signals or switches electrical current.

ex.en: The textbook introduces silicon transistor in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了硅晶体管。

ex.en: The author returns to silicon transistor when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了硅晶体管。

tip: 指电子元件；transistor radio才是晶体管收音机。

senses.en: Extremely beautiful and carefully made.
Describing a feeling or sensitivity of unusual intensity.

ex.en: The textbook introduces exquisite craftsmanship in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精湛工艺。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around exquisite craftsmanship.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精湛工艺展开说明。

tip: 常形容精美工艺；修饰pain时表示极其强烈。

senses.en: unable to work or exist together successfully
too different in character to have a good relationship

ex.en: The textbook introduces mutually incompatible in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了彼此不相容。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of mutually incompatible.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得彼此不相容这个例子。

tip: 固定搭配为incompatible with，不用incompatible to。

senses.en: The upper chamber of parliament in some countries
The governing council of ancient Rome

ex.en: I copied senate election into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把参议院选举抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of senate election.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得参议院选举这个例子。

col: a seat in the senate｜参议院席位
tip: 指特定国家的参议院时，通常写作the Senate。

senses.en: Logical and clear, with parts that fit together well.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a coherent argument.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于条理清楚的论证的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a coherent argument with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把条理清楚的论证和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a coherent argument｜条理清楚的论证
a coherent explanation｜连贯清晰的解释
a coherent strategy｜协调一致的策略
tip: 强调内容逻辑连贯；cohesive更强调各部分衔接紧密。

senses.en: Correct something that is wrong or unsatisfactory.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to rectify an error.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求纠正错误。

ex.en: The reading asks you to rectify an error and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你纠正错误，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 正式用词，常接error、mistake、situation。

senses.en: Already referred to earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used above-mentioned in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了上述的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up above-mentioned while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了上述的。

tip: 正式书面语，常置于名词前；写作中勿滥用。

senses.en: to make previously private or unknown information available

ex.en: The assignment is to disclose information, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先透露信息，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disclose information.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来透露信息。

col: disclose something to someone｜向某人透露某事
tip: 用disclose sth to sb；也可接that从句。

senses.en: strong annoyance caused by repeated problems or irritating behaviour

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sigh of exasperation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了恼火的叹息。

ex.en: The author returns to a sigh of exasperation when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了恼火的叹息。

col: a sigh of exasperation｜恼火的叹息
tip: 表示烦到失去耐心；勿与加剧混淆。

senses.en: Disagreement or conflict between people or groups.
A combination of musical sounds that clash unpleasantly.

ex.en: Office hours began with social discord.
ex.zh: 答疑从社会不和开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of social discord.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会不和这个例子。

col: a source of discord｜纷争的根源
tip: 表示不和时通常不可数，语气比disagreement正式。

senses.en: welcoming people of different backgrounds and abilities
including all relevant costs
including both the first and last points of a range

ex.en: Office hours began with inclusive education.
ex.zh: 答疑从融合教育开始。

ex.en: The author returns to inclusive education when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了融合教育。

tip: inclusive of表示“包含”；日期范围后用它表示首尾均含。

senses.en: Relating to a system exchanging land for service and loyalty.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the feudal system.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论封建制度。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of the feudal system.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得封建制度这个例子。

tip: 主要描述土地换取效忠与服役的历史制度。

senses.en: Ordinary written language, rather than poetry

ex.en: I copied clear prose into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把清晰的行文抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects clear prose with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把清晰的行文和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 不可数；不限于文学散文，也包括小说等非韵文。

senses.en: to make a process simpler and more efficient
to shape something to move easily through air or water

ex.en: The assignment is to streamline operations, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先精简运营流程，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can streamline operations follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够精简运营流程的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 通常作动词；“流线型的”用 streamlined。

senses.en: One part or aspect of a complex subject.
A small flat surface on a cut stone.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about every facet.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于每个方面的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around every facet.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕每个方面展开说明。

col: a facet of life｜生活的一个方面
tip: 常用 a facet of，指复杂事物的一个方面。

senses.en: Speed of movement, including direction in physics.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about high velocity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于高速的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of high velocity.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得高速这个例子。

tip: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。

senses.en: Belonging naturally to something, rather than coming from outside

ex.en: The textbook introduces intrinsic value in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了内在价值。

ex.en: A campus survey used intrinsic value to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用内在价值来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: intrinsic to表示“……所固有的”。

senses.en: Gradually become smaller in amount, size, or number.

ex.en: The assignment is to dwindle to nothing, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先逐渐减至零，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to dwindle to nothing.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得逐渐减至零。

tip: 不及物动词，强调逐渐减少，不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: a part that moves inside a cylinder in engines or pumps

ex.en: Office hours began with piston ring.
ex.zh: 答疑从活塞环开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss piston ring.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论活塞环的材料。

tip: 活塞在 cylinder（气缸）内往复运动。

senses.en: to control an entire market or supply of something
to use something so much that others cannot share it

ex.en: I heard the lecturer monopolize the market during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时垄断市场。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to monopolize the market.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得垄断市场。

col: monopolize someone's attention｜独占某人的注意力
tip: 英式也常拼作monopolise；可指市场或注意力。

senses.en: unable to live forever
causing or likely to cause death
a human being who cannot live forever

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about mortal wound.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于致命伤的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mortal wound.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕致命伤展开说明。

tip: mortal指凡人；死亡率用mortality，不用mortal。

senses.en: The act or written notice of leaving a job voluntarily.
Calm acceptance of something unpleasant that seems impossible to change.

ex.en: I copied hand in your resignation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把提交辞职信抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used hand in your resignation to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用提交辞职信来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: hand in your resignation｜提交辞职信
tip: 辞职用resignation；另一义是无奈接受，不是反抗。

senses.en: Careful not to upset or offend people.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on tactful approach.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论得体的处理方式。

ex.en: The author returns to tactful approach when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了得体的处理方式。

tip: 强调顾及他人感受、言行得体，不是反应机敏。

senses.en: a unit used to measure electric current

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about one ampere of current.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一安培电流的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around one ampere of current.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一安培电流展开说明。

col: electric current in amperes｜以安培计的电流
one ampere of current｜一安培电流
tip: 符号为A；口语常缩为amp，复数加s。

senses.en: To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to amend a law.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求修订法律。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to amend a law.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们修订法律。

tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理实物通常用mend。

senses.en: a poor farmer working a small plot of land

ex.en: Office hours began with peasant farmer.
ex.zh: 答疑从小农开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around peasant farmer.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕小农展开说明。

tip: 多用于历史或传统农业语境；称呼他人可能带贬义。

senses.en: Required by a law or rule.

ex.en: I copied mandatory training into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把强制培训抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used mandatory training to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用强制培训来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 常用于法规或制度要求；反义词为optional。

senses.en: Someone who takes over another person's job or position.
Something that replaces an earlier thing of the same kind.

ex.en: The textbook introduces likely successor in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可能的接班人。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around likely successor.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕可能的接班人展开说明。

tip: 用successor to sb；不专指财产继承人。

senses.en: A range of related ideas, qualities, or possibilities
A range of colours or waves arranged by wavelength or frequency

ex.en: Our professor circled the visible spectrum on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可见光谱。

ex.en: The author returns to the visible spectrum when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可见光谱。

col: a broad spectrum of｜广泛的各种……
across the spectrum｜涵盖整个范围
tip: 复数可用spectra或spectrums。

senses.en: An official responsible for keeping formal records.
A hospital doctor receiving advanced specialist training in Britain.

ex.en: Our professor circled university registrar on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了大学注册主任。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss university registrar.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大学注册主任的材料。

tip: 既可指登记官，也可指英国接受专科培训的医生。

senses.en: protection from danger, trouble, or bad weather
a safe place offering protection from danger or difficulty

ex.en: I copied seek refuge into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把寻求庇护抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around seek refuge.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕寻求庇护展开说明。

col: a refuge from｜躲避……的庇护处
tip: take/seek refuge in表示“在……避难”；refuge通常作名词。

senses.en: Too brightly coloured or heavily decorated to look attractive.

ex.en: Office hours began with gaudy colours.
ex.zh: 答疑从俗艳的色彩开始。

ex.en: The author returns to gaudy colours when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了俗艳的色彩。

tip: 含贬义，指颜色或装饰过分抢眼，不只是鲜艳。

senses.en: Producing many works, results or achievements.
Producing many young, flowers, fruits or seeds.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a prolific writer.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于多产作家的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a prolific writer.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得多产作家这个例子。

col: a prolific breeder｜繁殖力强的动物
tip: 强调产出多，不等于作品质量一定高。

senses.en: In spite of what has just been said.

ex.en: The sample was small; the pattern was clear nonetheless.
ex.zh: 样本很小，尽管如此，模式仍然清楚。

ex.en: Nonetheless, the author treats the result as a reason to repeat the study.
ex.zh: 尽管如此，作者仍把这一结果视为重复研究的理由。

col: nonetheless important｜尽管如此仍然重要
tip: 语气比 however 更书面，阅读里很常见。

senses.en: a field of grass, often containing wildflowers

ex.en: The textbook introduces wildflower meadow in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野花草地。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of wildflower meadow.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得野花草地这个例子。

tip: meadow多指乡间草地，不是修剪整齐的lawn。

senses.en: Appear as a large, often threatening or unclear shape.
Seem likely to happen soon, causing worry.
A machine or frame used to weave cloth.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to loom over.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求赫然耸立于……之上。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to loom over.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们赫然耸立于……之上。

col: loom large｜显得突出而令人担忧
tip: 动词常带压迫或担忧感；loom large指问题突出。

senses.en: Travelling faster than sound, or involving such speeds.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about supersonic speed.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于超音速的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to supersonic speed when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了超音速。

tip: 指速度超过声速；“超声波的”通常用ultrasonic。

senses.en: Legal responsibility for something, especially damage or loss.
Money owed by a person or organisation.
Someone or something that creates problems or disadvantages.

ex.en: Office hours began with legal liability.
ex.zh: 答疑从法律责任开始。

ex.en: The reading connects legal liability with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把法律责任和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 责任常不可数；债务常用复数liabilities。

senses.en: relating to the study of knowledge, existence, and values
accepting difficulties calmly as a natural part of life

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about philosophical question.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于哲学问题的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used philosophical question to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用哲学问题来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: philosophical about setbacks｜对挫折持豁达态度
tip: be philosophical about表示对不如意的事想得开。

senses.en: An additional, often unexpected consequence of an action or decision.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize ramification in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出间接后果。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up ramification while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了间接后果。

col: have ramifications for｜对……产生后续影响
tip: 通常用复数ramifications，常指复杂或意外后果。

senses.en: a device that increases the strength of sound or electrical signals

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a guitar amplifier.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于吉他扩音器的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a guitar amplifier to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用吉他扩音器来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: amplifier放大信号；speaker把信号转为声音。

senses.en: to fix something firmly inside a surrounding material
to place digital content within a webpage or document
to make something an established part of a system or culture

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to embed a video.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何嵌入视频。

ex.en: The reading asks you to embed a video and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你嵌入视频，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 过去式embedded，分词embedding均双写d。

senses.en: A misleading change in how facts or ideas are presented.
An unwanted change in shape, sound, or appearance.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about image distortion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于图像失真的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects image distortion with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把图像失真和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a distortion of the facts｜对事实的歪曲
tip: distortion of the facts指歪曲事实。

senses.en: To strike forcefully, especially with a whip or like one.
To fasten things tightly together using rope or cord.
An eyelash, or a stroke delivered with a whip.

ex.en: The professor asked us to lash against the windows.
ex.zh: 教授让我们猛烈拍打窗户。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to lash against the windows.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猛烈拍打窗户。

col: lash against the windows｜猛烈拍打窗户
lash out at｜猛烈抨击；攻击
tip: lash out at可指突然攻击或猛烈抨击。

senses.en: A reduction in the amount of something available

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about resource depletion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于资源耗竭的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to resource depletion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了资源耗竭。

tip: 常接of，表示资源或储备减少，不一定已耗尽。

senses.en: successful or showing great happiness after winning

ex.en: The textbook introduces triumphant smile in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了得意的微笑。

ex.en: A campus survey used triumphant smile to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用得意的微笑来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: 既可指取得胜利，也可形容获胜后的得意神情。

senses.en: Able to recover quickly after difficulties or damage
Able to return to its original shape after being bent

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on resilient communities.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论适应力强的社区。

ex.en: A campus survey used resilient communities to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用适应力强的社区来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: resilient to shocks｜能抵御冲击的
tip: 既可形容人或经济的韧性，也可指材料回弹。

senses.en: To use something incorrectly or for a harmful purpose.
The incorrect or harmful use of something.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to misuse personal data.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须滥用个人数据。

ex.en: The passage says students who can misuse personal data follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够滥用个人数据的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: misuse personal data｜滥用个人数据
misuse of resources｜资源的不当使用
tip: 动词词尾读/ z /，名词词尾读/ s /。

senses.en: Allowed by law or accepted rules.
Fair, reasonable, and supported by good reasons.

ex.en: Office hours began with legitimate business.
ex.zh: 答疑从合法生意开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of legitimate business.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得合法生意这个例子。

tip: 既可指法律允许，也可指理由或担忧合理。

senses.en: work with others to create or achieve something
help an enemy controlling your country

ex.en: The professor asked us to collaborate with colleagues.
ex.zh: 教授让我们与同事合作。

ex.en: The passage says students who can collaborate with colleagues follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够与同事合作的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: collaborate on a project｜合作开展项目
tip: 与某人合作用with；合作做某项目用on。

senses.en: Expressing ideas clearly, powerfully, and beautifully.
Clearly expressing a feeling or meaning without words.

ex.en: The textbook introduces an eloquent speaker in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能言善辩的演讲者。

ex.en: The author returns to an eloquent speaker when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了能言善辩的演讲者。

col: an eloquent speaker｜能言善辩的演讲者
an eloquent silence｜意味深长的沉默
tip: 不只形容口才，也可形容传达深意的眼神或沉默。

senses.en: To make someone curious and eager to learn more.
Secret planning intended to gain power or an advantage.

ex.en: The professor explained intrigue with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了引起兴趣。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up intrigue while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了引起兴趣。

col: a web of intrigue｜错综复杂的阴谋
tip: 激起兴趣时是及物动词；常用 be intrigued by。

senses.en: Someone who is extremely enthusiastic about an activity or interest.
Someone whose extreme beliefs make them reject other views.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fitness fanatic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了健身狂。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fitness fanatic.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论健身狂的材料。

tip: 爱好语境可轻松使用；信仰语境常含贬义。

senses.en: the most important quality that makes something what it is
a concentrated liquid containing a particular flavour or scent

ex.en: The textbook introduces vanilla essence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了香草香精。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vanilla essence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕香草香精展开说明。

tip: in essence 表示“本质上”，用于概括核心观点。

senses.en: Showing practical judgment based on ordinary experience.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a commonsense approach in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了务实合理的方法。

ex.en: A campus survey used a commonsense approach to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用务实合理的方法来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a commonsense approach｜务实合理的方法
commonsense precautions｜合乎常识的预防措施
tip: 形容词也写作common-sense；名词common sense分写。

senses.en: To pay careful attention to advice or a warning.
Careful attention given to something, especially advice or warnings.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to heed a warning.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须听从警告。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers heed a warning before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要听从警告。

tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用于pay heed to。

senses.en: To use authority to reject or reverse a decision or objection.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer overrule an objection during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时驳回异议。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers overrule an objection before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要驳回异议。

tip: 强调凭更高权力否决，不只是表示不同意。

senses.en: To necessarily involve or require something

ex.en: The professor asked us to entail costs.
ex.zh: 教授让我们需要花费。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers entail costs before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要需要花费。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：entail doing，不接to do。

senses.en: A distinctive quality that characterises someone or something
An official mark showing the purity of a precious metal

ex.en: The textbook introduces a distinctive hallmark in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了鲜明特征。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a distinctive hallmark.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论鲜明特征的材料。

col: a hallmark of quality｜品质的标志
bear the hallmarks of｜具有……的典型特征
tip: 常用a hallmark of，表示……的典型特征。

senses.en: A tooth on a gear, or the gear itself
Someone with a small role in a large organisation

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about broken cog.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于断裂的轮齿的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss broken cog.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论断裂的轮齿的材料。

col: a cog in the machine｜机构中的小角色
tip: a cog in the machine比喻机构中的小角色。

senses.en: A natural tendency to develop a particular illness or condition.
A natural tendency to behave or think in a particular way.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about genetic predisposition.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于遗传易感性的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss genetic predisposition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论遗传易感性的材料。

col: a predisposition to diabetes｜糖尿病易感体质
a predisposition towards anxiety｜焦虑倾向
tip: 常接to；表示更易发生，不代表必然发生。

senses.en: To express sadness or regret about something.
An expression of grief, sometimes through a song or poem.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to lament the loss of.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须为失去……而悲叹。

ex.en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to lament the loss of.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们为失去……而悲叹。

col: lament the loss of｜为失去……而悲叹
a lament for｜为……而作的哀歌
tip: 较正式；动词可直接接宾语，也可接that从句。

senses.en: clear, definite, and easy to notice

ex.en: Our professor circled a decided advantage on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了明显的优势。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a decided advantage.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论明显的优势的材料。

tip: 形容词常指“明显的”；“果断的”通常用decisive。

senses.en: to show through evidence that something is not true

ex.en: The professor asked us to disprove a theory.
ex.zh: 教授让我们证伪理论。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to disprove a theory.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们证伪理论。

col: disprove a claim｜证明说法不实
tip: 不只是表示反对，而是用证据证明说法错误。

senses.en: Extremely important and needing to be done.
Something that must be done or given urgent attention.
Expressing a command or instruction in grammar.

ex.en: Our professor circled moral imperative on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道义上必须做的事。

ex.en: The author returns to moral imperative when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了道义上必须做的事。

col: it is imperative that｜……至关重要
imperative to act｜必须采取行动
moral imperative｜道义上必须做的事
tip: 常用It is imperative to do或that从句。

senses.en: to dig into ground and remove earth
to uncover ancient objects or buildings by carefully removing earth

ex.en: The lab instructions say to excavate a site.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发掘遗址。

ex.en: When the class discussed historical change, the speaker told us to excavate a site.
ex.zh: 全班讨论历史变迁时，讲者让我们发掘遗址。

col: excavate ancient remains｜发掘古代遗存
tip: excavate可用于工程挖掘，也可用于考古发掘。

senses.en: a final demand threatening consequences if it is not accepted

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize ultimatum in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出最后通牒。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up ultimatum while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了最后通牒。

col: issue an ultimatum｜发出最后通牒
give someone an ultimatum｜向某人下最后通牒
reject an ultimatum｜拒绝最后通牒
tip: 常用give someone an ultimatum；复数常为ultimatums。

senses.en: The ability to recover or adapt after difficulties
The ability of a material to regain its original shape

ex.en: The textbook introduces emotional resilience in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了情绪复原力。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss emotional resilience.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论情绪复原力的材料。

col: show remarkable resilience｜展现非凡的复原力
tip: 通常不可数，强调受挫后的恢复与适应能力。

senses.en: The activity of fighting wars, including methods and weapons used.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about modern warfare.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于现代战争的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of modern warfare.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得现代战争这个例子。

tip: 不可数，强调作战活动或方式；war可指一场战争。

senses.en: strong public praise for someone or something
to praise someone or something publicly and enthusiastically

ex.en: Our professor circled critical acclaim on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了评论界的赞誉。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around critical acclaim.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕评论界的赞誉展开说明。

tip: 名词通常不可数；动词常用be acclaimed as被誉为。

senses.en: To make something more attractive by decorating it.

ex.en: The professor asked us to adorn the walls.
ex.zh: 教授让我们装点墙壁。

ex.en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to adorn the walls.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们装点墙壁。

col: adorn something with flowers｜用鲜花装饰某物
tip: 用adorn A with B表示“用B装饰A”。

senses.en: An official order issued by a ruler, government, or court.
To officially order or decide that something must happen.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize decree in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出法令。

ex.en: A reading on public institutions uses decree when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于公共制度的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了法令。

tip: 动词可接that从句；名词指有权威的正式命令。

senses.en: To increase something by adding to it.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer augment income during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时增加收入。

ex.en: The passage says students who can augment income follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够增加收入的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: augment existing resources｜补充现有资源
tip: 较正式，通常作及物动词，强调通过添加来增加。

senses.en: Cruel or unfair control that denies people freedom and rights.

ex.en: Our professor circled political oppression on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治压迫。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss political oppression.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政治压迫的材料。

col: freedom from oppression｜免受压迫的自由
tip: 通常为不可数名词；动词是oppress。

senses.en: an unusually strong enthusiasm for an activity or object
a mental health state involving extreme energy and elevated mood

ex.en: Our professor circled an episode of mania on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一次躁狂发作。

ex.en: A campus survey used an episode of mania to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一次躁狂发作来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: an episode of mania｜一次躁狂发作
tip: 日常可指狂热；医学上的躁狂不等于普通兴奋。

senses.en: Able to catch fire easily.

ex.en: I copied highly inflammable into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高度易燃的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly inflammable.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕高度易燃的展开说明。

tip: inflammable是易燃的；不易燃用non-flammable。

senses.en: someone authorised to act or vote for another person
something used to represent or measure something else indirectly
a server that passes requests between users and other servers

ex.en: Office hours began with vote by proxy.
ex.zh: 答疑从委托代理人投票开始。

ex.en: The author returns to vote by proxy when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了委托代理人投票。

col: vote by proxy｜委托代理人投票
act as a proxy｜担任代理人
tip: by proxy指通过代理人；a proxy for可指替代指标。

senses.en: to prevent someone or something from moving or acting freely
to control a feeling, reaction, or increase

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to restrain anger.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须克制愤怒。

ex.en: The passage says students who can restrain anger follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够克制愤怒的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: restrain someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
tip: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。

senses.en: Strong, flexible tissue found in joints and other body parts.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on damaged cartilage.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论受损软骨。

ex.en: The reading connects damaged cartilage with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把受损软骨和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；不是骨头，而是有弹性的组织。

senses.en: To form a clear picture of something in your mind.
To represent information using images, charts, or diagrams.

ex.en: The professor asked us to visualize a scene.
ex.zh: 教授让我们想象一个场景。

ex.en: The reading asks you to visualize a scene and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你想象一个场景，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: visualize a scene｜想象一个场景
tip: 英式也写visualise；可接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to present information in a misleading or inaccurate way
to change the natural shape, appearance, or sound of something

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to distort the truth.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何歪曲真相。

ex.en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers distort the truth before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要歪曲真相。

col: distort public perception｜扭曲公众认知
tip: 既可指歪曲事实，也可指图像、声音失真。

senses.en: To clearly represent an idea, quality, or feeling.
To include something as part of a larger whole.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to embody an ideal.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须体现一种理想。

ex.en: The reading asks you to embody an ideal and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你体现一种理想，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: embody an ideal｜体现一种理想
embody the spirit of｜体现……的精神
embody core values｜体现核心价值观
tip: embody是及物动词，直接接所体现的品质或理念。

senses.en: To delight someone greatly and hold their attention.
To put someone or something under a magic spell.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to enchant an audience.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须使观众陶醉。

ex.en: The reading asks you to enchant an audience and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你使观众陶醉，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 常用被动结构 be enchanted by，表示被深深吸引。

senses.en: the whole of something, with no part left out

ex.en: Office hours began with the entirety of.
ex.zh: 答疑从……的全部开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used the entirety of to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用……的全部来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用 in its entirety，表示完整地、无遗漏地。

senses.en: A group of countries or people acting together for shared aims.

ex.en: Office hours began with trading bloc.
ex.zh: 答疑从贸易集团开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around trading bloc.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕贸易集团展开说明。

tip: 与block同音；bloc专指共同采取行动的集团。

senses.en: Relating to the final profit or financial outcome.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used bottom-line in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了关乎最终利润的。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses bottom-line when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了关乎最终利润的。

col: bottom-line impact｜对最终利润的影响
tip: 连字符形式常作定语；名词写bottom line。

senses.en: A serious infectious disease, especially one caused by plague bacteria.
To cause repeated trouble or suffering.
A widespread problem or harmful invasion.

ex.en: I copied an outbreak of plague into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把鼠疫暴发抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of an outbreak of plague.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得鼠疫暴发这个例子。

col: an outbreak of plague｜鼠疫暴发
be plagued by problems｜饱受问题困扰
tip: 动词常用be plagued by，表示长期反复受困扰。

senses.en: mix together while remaining partly distinct
move around a group and talk to different people

ex.en: The professor asked us to mingle with.
ex.zh: 教授让我们与……混合；与……交往。

ex.en: The reading asks you to mingle with and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你与……混合；与……交往，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: mingle with既可指与某物混合，也可指与人交往。

senses.en: To strongly want to achieve something important.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to aspire to greatness.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须追求卓越。

ex.en: The passage says students who can aspire to greatness follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够追求卓越的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: aspire to do something｜立志做某事
aspire to a career in medicine｜立志从医
tip: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to后也可接名词。

senses.en: Originating or living naturally in a place, rather than arriving later.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about indigenous peoples.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于原住民族的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of indigenous peoples.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得原住民族这个例子。

col: indigenous to an area｜原产于某地区
tip: 常用indigenous to；修饰人群时常将首字母大写。

senses.en: Ignoring danger or the possible harmful results of an action

ex.en: Office hours began with reckless driving.
ex.zh: 答疑从鲁莽驾驶开始。

ex.en: The author returns to reckless driving when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了鲁莽驾驶。

col: reckless disregard for safety｜对安全的肆意漠视
tip: 比careless更强调明知有风险仍不顾后果。

senses.en: The process of burning waste until it becomes ash.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on waste incineration.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论垃圾焚烧。

ex.en: A campus survey used waste incineration to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用垃圾焚烧来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于垃圾处理话题。

senses.en: to make people behave more politely or develop organized societies

ex.en: The professor asked us to civilize society.
ex.zh: 教授让我们使社会文明化。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to civilize society.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使社会文明化。

tip: 谈论民族时易带优越或殖民色彩；英式也拼 civilise。

senses.en: the state of no longer being used

ex.en: The textbook introduces years of disuse in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多年的闲置。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss years of disuse.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论多年的闲置的材料。

col: fall into disuse｜逐渐废弃不用
tip: 通常作不可数名词，词尾读/s/，不是/z/。

senses.en: a group of similar things positioned or occurring close together
to gather closely together or make things gather together

ex.en: The textbook introduces industrial cluster in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了产业集群。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of industrial cluster.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得产业集群这个例子。

tip: 强调紧密聚集；a cluster of后常接复数名词。

senses.en: Spending much time studying and enjoying learning.
Done with deliberate care and close attention.

ex.en: Our professor circled a studious pupil on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了勤奋好学的学生。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a studious pupil.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕勤奋好学的学生展开说明。

col: a studious pupil｜勤奋好学的学生
tip: 形容人多指勤学；studious avoidance指刻意回避。

senses.en: To lose something as a penalty for breaking a rule.
Something surrendered or done as a penalty, especially in games.
Lost or required to be surrendered as a penalty.

ex.en: The professor asked us to forfeit a deposit.
ex.zh: 教授让我们损失押金。

ex.en: The passage says students who can forfeit a deposit follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够损失押金的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: forfeit the right to｜丧失……的权利
forfeit a match｜被判比赛失利
tip: 主语通常是失去财物者，而非执行没收的一方。

senses.en: the origin of something, especially a word
the process of forming something from an existing source

ex.en: The textbook introduces word derivation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了词的派生。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around word derivation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕词的派生展开说明。

col: the derivation of a word｜一个词的词源
the derivation of a formula｜公式的推导
tip: 动词搭配为derive A from B，意为A源自B。

senses.en: Failure to support someone or something you should remain faithful to

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an act of disloyalty.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论背信行为。

ex.en: The author returns to an act of disloyalty when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了背信行为。

col: an act of disloyalty｜背信行为
accuse someone of disloyalty｜指责某人不忠
tip: 是名词；形容词用disloyal，常接to。
